name: docs-sync
title: Documentation Sync Pipeline
description: Automates CHANGELOG, README, and roadmap updates after releases using git log and GitHub issue tracking.
author: SolSolis-Sys

inputs.name: previous_tag
inputs.description: Previous release tag for git log range (e.g., v1.1.0). Leave empty to use last tag automatically.

loop.exit_condition: All three agents (changelog-analyzer, readme-updater, roadmap-syncer) completed successfully
